in_sanskrit.name: च्छया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who provides relief from the scorching sun, a symbol of the divine mother who shields her child with her love.

in_hindi.name: च्छया
in_hindi.long_meaning: कृपाशिल्पा, स्कन्द की पत्नी (Shady, Kind, Wife of Lord Skanda)

in_marathi.name: Chhayaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhayaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Chhayaa means shadow or reflection. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word chhaya, which refers to a cool retreat from the heat or a relief from troubles. In Hindu mythology, Chhayaa is the name of a goddess who is believed to provide shade and protection to her devotees.
